description: Use this tool to find COURT DECISIONS (Rechtsprechung): 1,050,000+ Swiss federal and cantonal decisions plus ~2,800 ECtHR decisions concerning Switzerland. Full-text search with keywords, phrases (in quotes), Boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT), prefix matching (word*), docket lookup (6B_1234/2025) and column-scoped search (regeste:keyword). Filter by court, canton, language, date range, chamber. Results are relevance-ranked and enriched with citation counts, statute references and is_leading_case. Use offset to page. Newest decision dates: empty query + sort='date_desc' + court filter. Newly PUBLISHED decisions (alerts): published_from + sort='published_desc'. Not for statutes (search_laws), commentary (search_scholarship), or administrative guidance (search_practice).

canton.description: Filter by canton (CH for federal, ZH, BE, GE, etc.)

chamber.description: Filter by chamber/division (substring match). Examples: 'Abteilung V' (BVGer asylum), 'Zivilrechtliche', 'CASSO', 'Strafrechtliche'

court.description: Filter by court code. Federal: bger, bge, bvger, bstger, bpatger, mkg. European Court of Human Rights: bge_egmr (BGE-published DE translations, Swiss cases), hudoc_ch (HUDOC Switzerland-tagged), ecthr_chamber and ecthr_grand_chamber (all respondent states, importance 1-3, FR or EN). ecthr_committee is empty by design — the Committee's docket is entirely importance 4. UN treaty bodies (decisions on individual communications, all States, FR or EN): untb_ccpr, untb_cat, untb_cerd, untb_cedaw, untb_crc, untb_crpd, untb_cescr, untb_ced; unwgad = Working Group on Arbitrary Detention opinions (2010-); canton='CH' for cases against Switzerland. Court of Justice of the EU: cjeu (judgments on the EU acts Swiss courts follow — Brussels/Lugano, Dublin/Schengen, free movement and social security, air passengers, VAT, data protection; German text, FR/IT keywords). International Court of Justice: icj (judgments, advisory opinions, substantive orders; FR, else EN). Cantonal: zh_obergericht, be_verwaltungsgericht, etc.

date_from.description: Decided on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD): decision_date, not publication_date.

date_to.description: Decided on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD): decision_date, not publication_date.

fields.description: Response detail level: 'full' (default) includes snippet/regeste/URL, 'compact' returns only docket, date, court, language, decision_id.

include_pinpoint.description: Attach a pinpoint Erwägung citation to the top results when a confident match exists (BM25 over the per-decision Erwägungen FTS5 index, gap-confidence ≥ medium). Defaults true; set false to skip the per-result lookup (typically saves 0.2-2 s on the top 5 results; more for long or statute-heavy queries).

language.description: OPTIONAL filter. Restricts results to ONE language. Omit (recommended default) to search across all languages — Swiss federal decisions are issued in DE, FR, or IT depending on the case, so a language filter silently excludes valid hits in the other two. Set ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a single-language result; do NOT auto-apply based on the conversation's language. 'en' reaches only ECtHR judgments whose sole authoritative text is English — there is no English Swiss case law.

limit.description: Max results to return (max 2000). Omit to use default of 50. Do not set low values like 5 or 10 unless the user explicitly asked for fewer results.

marked_for_publication.description: If true, return only Federal Supreme Court rulings flagged for the official BGE collection (the Neuheiten '*' marker, 'für die Publikation vorgesehen') — future leading cases, flagged before the BGE number is assigned. Populated for BGer decisions published from mid-2026 onward; older rows are unflagged.

offset.description: Skip this many results (for pagination). Default 0.

published_from.description: Only decisions the court PUBLISHED on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD) — publication_date, not decision_date. Use this, not date_from, for a 'what is newly published' alert: the Federal Supreme Court often publishes weeks or months after it rules. May be limited to decisions decided up to 18 months before published_from (always without a court filter); the response then names the limit in publication_window_decided_from, and an earlier date_from widens it. publication_date exists for BGer rulings published since May 2026, BVGer, BStGer and several cantonal courts (VD, VS, BS, SG and others); decisions without one never match. BGer rulings are indexed the day they are published, other courts with the nightly rebuild, up to two days later: for a recurring alert, start each run's window 3 days back and skip decision_ids already reported.

published_to.description: Only decisions published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Requires published_from.

query.description:
Search query. Best results: 3-8 precise terms, one search per legal issue — never paste document text. Max 4,000 chars; input over 500 chars is auto-condensed to its citations + key terms. Examples:
- Simple: Mietrecht Kündigung
- Phrase: "Treu und Glauben"
- Boolean: Arbeitsrecht AND Kündigung NOT Probezeit
- Prefix: Verfassung*
- By docket: 6B_1234/2025
- By article: "Art. 8 BV"
- Column: regeste:Mietrecht AND full_text:Kündigung

sort.description: Sort order: 'relevance' (default for FTS), 'date_desc' / 'date_asc' (decision_date), 'published_desc' (newest publication_date first; decisions without one last).

name: search_decisions

canonical_decision_id.description: The canonical decision_id when the representation manifest is loaded: equals decision_id unless this record is a duplicate representation of another stored decision. decision_id itself is never changed.
canonical_decision_id.title: Canonical Decision Id

ignored_arguments.description: MCP parameters that were ignored; they did not affect the returned result.
ignored_arguments.title: Ignored Arguments

is_canonical.description: Whether this record is the canonical representation (canonical_decision_id == decision_id). Absent when the manifest is not loaded.
is_canonical.title: Is Canonical

joined_dockets.description: Secondary dockets of a consolidated proceeding stored under this decision; a reference by any of them names this record. Absent when there are none.
joined_dockets.title: Joined Dockets

regeste_source.description: Set only when `regeste` was not stored on this record itself but copied verbatim from a safely-linked representation named here (design doc §4) — e.g. a cantonal procedure-number record harvesting the headnote from its decision-number twin. Cite the requested decision, never this id.
regeste_source.title: Regeste Source

representations.description: Other safely-linked representations of this same canonical decision (e.g. a cantonal portal's procedure number vs. its decision number) that search collapsed into this one hit, each as {decision_id, relation_type, evidence_method, confidence, source_url}. Present only on a row that actually folded another one in; absent otherwise, including when this record is itself an unfolded member or canonical.
representations.title: Representations

ignored_arguments.description: MCP parameters that were ignored; they did not affect the returned result.
ignored_arguments.title: Ignored Arguments

decisions.description: Legacy MCP widget records, retained alongside results.
decisions.title: Decisions

degraded.description: True when the search hit its time budget and skipped ranking strategies; the page is a degraded ranking, not the best matches.
degraded.title: Degraded

has_more.description: Whether another page is retrievable. False does not prove a relevance-ranked search enumerated the corpus.
has_more.title: Has More

ignored_arguments.description: MCP parameters that were ignored; they did not affect the returned result.
ignored_arguments.title: Ignored Arguments

publication_window_decided_from.description: Set on a publication-date query (published_from / sort=published_desc): the earliest decision_date it considered. Decisions decided earlier are not in the result; pass an earlier date_from to include them.
publication_window_decided_from.title: Publication Window Decided From

total.description: Match count; see total_is_lower_bound before treating it as exact.
total.title: Total
